description: This file contains the EngineeringValidations class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing static validation methods for numeric types such as float and integer, primarily used for engineering calculations.

classes.name: EngineeringValidations
classes.description: Provides static methods for validating numeric inputs for engineering calculations.

methods.name: validateFloat
methods.description: Validates that the input value is numeric and returns it as a float; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that the input value is numeric, converts it to a float, floors it, and returns as an integer; throws an exception if invalid.
